Why — where it started

Built by doctors, for doctors,
and now to help form better doctors.

It started as a request from a medical school: give our students a place to practice real cases, and give us the evidence that they’re improving.

We took it on because it maps to what we care about — forming higher-quality doctors, and better care for everyone they’ll go on to treat.

How Telepatía Learning works
